This spot check indicates strong translation quality for the three languages reviewed (French, German, and Spanish), with an average accuracy rating of 4.6 out of 5 and only 3 of 60 articles requiring correction.

However, this report does not support conclusions about quality across all nine languages. The key limitation is that coverage was restricted to those three languages; the other six languages we publish in, including Japanese, Arabic, and Polish, were not checked. Consequently, there is no data available here regarding the accuracy of the remaining languages.

This study does not provide data on meeting room usage across the whole building. It only measured the 3rd floor (12 rooms), while floors 1, 2, and 4 (34 rooms) had no sensors and were not measured. For the 3rd floor specifically, average occupancy during booked hours was 46%, and 22% of bookings went unused. The primary limitation is that because 34 rooms on other floors were excluded, these findings cannot be generalized to represent the entire building.

Therefore, these results cannot be applied to the full language portfolio.
